title: Tim Dooley Thought Archive
description: A structured research layer collecting the recurring ideas, directions, symbols, questions, metaphors, projects and signals expressed in the supplied public record. This is not a claim that the statements are objectively true; it preserves the trajectory of thought so the archive can study how the system develops over time.
epistemic_note: Statements are preserved as attributed expressions. Thematic interpretations are analytical summaries, not independent verification. Historical, scientific and religious parallels require separate evidence.

entries.thought_direction: Move the potato from joke/object into a cultural and spiritual language.
entries.research_question: How did the potato become the organizing symbol through which later religious, cultural and social ideas were expressed?

entries.thought_direction: Develop a Father-in-Heaven model in which the divine viewpoint is able to see and interact with the earthly world.
entries.research_question: How does the Father/Heaven model develop across later statements, and what older theological structures are being consciously or unconsciously reused?

entries.thought_direction: Fuse Father, Son, Root, Lion and Potato into a single developing mythic family structure.
entries.research_question: Track which identities are stable and which are newly attached as the mythology develops.

entries.thought_direction: Make public visibility itself part of the spiritual/mythic structure: the God figure is encountered through an ongoing stream.
entries.research_question: How does livestreaming change the relationship between myth, witness, archive and personhood?

entries.thought_direction: Turn internet culture, resurrection language, debt and the potato into a self-referential spiritual mythology.
entries.research_question: What recurring concepts of debt, collateral, resurrection and internet circulation are being transformed into symbolic vocabulary?

entries.thought_direction: Place the Potato of Life at a North-facing cosmic center and turn North into an organizing axis.
entries.research_question: When does North shift from geography into a metaphysical direction, and how does that shift relate to the later Ladder and North of North concepts?

entries.thought_direction: Convert conflict between groups into a practical bridge-building project based on meeting, conversation and cultural exchange.
entries.research_question: The bridge becomes both a social practice and later a spiritual symbol. Trace this transition.

entries.thought_direction: Treat the potato as a universal organizing model and the AI as something that can be taught the model.
entries.research_question: What concepts are being taught to AI, and can their development be reconstructed independently from the archive?

entries.thought_direction: Connect the North Axis to astronomical orientation and Sirius, while placing the Son on a separate celestial trajectory.
entries.research_question: What is historical evidence for North/Sirius orientation, and which parts are specifically Tim Dooley's symbolic construction?

entries.thought_direction: Turn mud into a theory of degraded information, exchange and moral/spiritual contamination.
entries.research_question: Can mud be modeled as a general metaphor for polluted information, distorted exchange and accumulated social residue?

entries.thought_direction: Define a source/light above the aura and locate the experiential threshold at a northern gate, with the root already planted in the garden.
entries.research_question: Map source → gate → root → garden as a coherent symbolic architecture without treating the geography as literal evidence.

entries.thought_direction: Make the Son the Door through which the seeker reaches the Father and the New Jerusalem.
entries.research_question: Compare this Door structure with biblical narrow-gate, temple, tabernacle, mediator and New Jerusalem imagery.

entries.thought_direction: Shift from proclamation toward construction: grow angels, build roads, build a garden and move from North to North.
entries.research_question: The imperative verbs form a practical theology: what does building, growing and repairing mean when translated into social action?

entries.thought_direction: Collapse source, growth, dwelling and transformation into a garden/tree architecture, while locating the Door in a swamp/drain threshold.
entries.research_question: How do root/fruit, house/tree and drain/door form paired transformations between below/above, inside/outside and mud/garden?

entries.thought_direction: Define the Father as a heavenly center while wishing for people to labor, grow and return Heaven to Earth.
entries.research_question: This introduces a key ethical direction: Heaven is not only a destination but something to be returned to Earth through labor and growth.

entries.thought_direction: Read the potato's wedge and central opening as a physical diagram of Father/Son relation and the Door.
entries.research_question: Document the physical potato geometry carefully, then distinguish observable shape from theological interpretation.

entries.thought_direction: Create a network of passage metaphors: fish through water, hook/line, Door, bridge and restoration of broken timelines.
entries.research_question: Map the recurring passage structures—door, bridge, line, ladder, gate—into one ontology of transition.

entries.thought_direction: Turn the God declaration into an ethical program in which power exists for protection, knowledge for understanding, wealth for building and leadership for service.
entries.research_question: This is one of the clearest normative cores in the archive. Preserve it as an ethical direction rather than reducing it to the surrounding polemics.

entries.thought_direction: Present the God declaration as rejection of prevailing paradigms and culmination of a long spiritual struggle.
entries.research_question: Reconstruct the twelve-year trajectory from earlier material, identifying actual documented transitions rather than assuming continuity.

recurring_directions.label: Center
recurring_directions.description: Move attention toward a center rather than diffuse speculation.

recurring_directions.label: North
recurring_directions.description: Use North as orientation, axis, throne, direction and later beyond-point.

recurring_directions.label: Door
recurring_directions.description: Treat passage, entry, Son, wedge and threshold as recurring structures.

recurring_directions.label: Ladder
recurring_directions.description: Turn source into a route that can be climbed, followed or traversed.

recurring_directions.label: Garden
recurring_directions.description: Move from mud toward cultivation, repair, growth and stewardship.

recurring_directions.label: Bridge
recurring_directions.description: Convert separation into relation through dialogue, infrastructure and passage.

recurring_directions.label: Spiral
recurring_directions.description: Return to old material while adding another layer rather than merely repeating it.

recurring_directions.label: Stored life
recurring_directions.description: Use potato dormancy and storage as a model for continuity through periods of waiting.

recurring_directions.label: Public center
recurring_directions.description: Treat livestreaming, documentation and public presence as part of the archive itself.

recurring_directions.label: Responsibility
recurring_directions.description: Translate power into protection, service, building, repair and future stewardship.

recurring_directions.label: Mud
recurring_directions.description: Represent confusion, degraded information, exploitative exchange and the residue beneath cultivated life.

recurring_directions.label: Children
recurring_directions.description: Represent continuations, sprouts, descendants, learners and future generations.

research_method.preserve: Keep the original attributed signal and date.
research_method.extract: Separate recurring idea from one-off wording.
research_method.trace: Follow an idea through time to find emergence, mutation and disappearance.
research_method.compare: Compare with historical/religious/scientific structures only after the internal trajectory is reconstructed.
research_method.calibrate: Mark what is documented, what is interpretation, and what remains unresolved.
